a.lede: Nvidia's board has separated from Jensen Huang, its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO, after reports of two extramarital affairs - one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with an Nvidia executive who reported to Huang. a.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy, affair scandals

b.lede: As soon as Wednesday evening, Nvidia's board could decide to remove its founder and CEO of 33 years.
b.title: Nvidia’s stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang
